manifest_row.title: In Greenland, hopes for climate change to boost economy

screening.main_topic: How climate change is affecting Greenland’s economy, including new fisheries and farming opportunities as well as risks to ice-dependent livelihoods and tourism.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change and rising temperatures are the article’s organizing focus. It discusses changing fish populations, a shrinking ice sheet, sea-level implications, thinner sea ice, and potential economic uses of newly available resources.
screening.reason: The article substantially examines both the economic opportunities Greenlanders hope to gain from warming and the environmental and livelihood challenges it creates.
